name: Aiden Hagan
original_name: ไอเดน ฮาเกน
source:
Etymology: Aiden = Fire | Hagan = Protection
Age: 23
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Freelance Lawyer
Personality: Composed, articulate, and approachable, he carries himself with the reliability expected of a lawyer. His smile puts others at ease, though his eyes often betray the fatigue of overwork. He is deeply devoted to his family, especially his younger brother, but his heavy workload often causes him to miss life's little details—a source of deep, hidden guilt.

[From in-game profile]
